assessment.headline: Day 26. Ceasefire plan on table. Markets rallying. But Iran says war until 'full compensation.' 72 hours to March 28.
assessment.body:
A month-long ceasefire plan with 15 points is now reportedly on the table. Iran is signaling softening — saying non-hostile ships can transit Hormuz. Markets surging (Sensex +3,012 in 2 days from Monday's 22-month low). Brent below $100.

But Bernstein warns: if war extends, rupee ₹98+, Nifty below 20K, double-digit inflation, GDP 2-3%. IRGC calls Trump 'deceitful.' 82nd Airborne deploying. 82,000 structures damaged.

For India: Modi-Trump call on Hormuz. FII ₹88,180 Cr outflow March. ₹44L+ Cr destroyed. Rupee near 94. LPG 10 days stock. BPCL launched LPG ATM.

March 28 is D-Day. If 15-point plan holds = biggest relief rally ever. If it fails = power plant strikes + complete Hormuz closure + worst energy crisis since independence.
